title: Rotation of a simplex within another one
summary: We are interested in the naive problem whether we can move a solid object in a solid box or not. We may restrict the movement to rotation. In the case we can rotate, the centre and the ``direction'' of rotation may be restricted. Simplifying, we consider possibility of rotation of a polytope within another one of the same dimension and give a criterion for the possibility. Consider the particular case of simplices of the same dimension assuming that the vertices of the inner simplex are contained in different facets of the outer one.
